test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Archana took a loan of ₹78,000 from a bank on 24th January 2012 at 8 (3)/(4)% per annum simple interest and paid it back on 18th June 2012. Find the total amount paid by Archana. (Approximated to nearest integer)
solution: **Given : ** Principal = Rs.78000 Time = 146 days Rate = 35/4 % **Formula Used : ** SI = (P × R × T)/100 **Calculation : ** Jan. = 8 days Feb. = 29 days
